description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
